sources.title: Atomic Runner Chelnov [SEGA GENESIS/MEGA DRIVE] Gameplay Walkthrough FULL GAME [4K60ᶠᵖˢ🔴]
sources.pixelScaling: Downloaded format308 is 1920×1440 / 59.94 from the uploader. Preserve 4:3 with pillarboxing; do not stretch to16:9. This task did not enlarge a low resolution media file.

inspection.method: All45seconds decoded to30contact samples in1.5second bins; five full resolution frames directly viewed; fullvideo+audio decode passed. Moving final edit and human audio listening remain separate.

observedBeforeActionResult.before: The runner approaches stone columns on a descending path; score and remaining lives are visible.
observedBeforeActionResult.action: The player traverses the scrolling ruins, jumps across height changes, and fires circular projectiles toward enemies.
observedBeforeActionResult.result: Projectiles and explosion effects appear while the player advances over slopes and platforms into the lava/brick corridor; score changes.
observedBeforeActionResult.turning: Not confirmed as a left/right direction change in the inspected45seconds. This capture has no input overlay; do not claim it demonstrates a particular turn button or miswired cabinet.

inspection.purpose: Short, specifically analysed example of a distinctive side-scrolling control design; show observable traversal, jump and firing beside the relevant explanation.
limitations: Genesis/Mega Drive version; not an arcade cabinet recording.
Keep the Kawaii Games watermark at lowerleft and the game HUD; do not crop credit or distort retro4:3.
No input display: actual held buttons, analog values or cabinet wiring cannot be read from this footage.
Exact final in/out and moving annotations require root’s final cut review.

primaryTechnicalEvidence.supports: Official game basics: accumulating damage, launching opponents, and returning to the stage.
primaryTechnicalEvidence.doesNotSupport: Does not establish Ultimate’s exact analog walk/dash thresholds.

primaryTechnicalEvidence.supports: Analog stick tilt amount affects walking speed; a quick left/right tap starts a dash that continues while held.
primaryTechnicalEvidence.limits: This previous entry’s manual supports the series principle. Do not present it as Ultimate specific numeric data. Normalized values such as 0, 0.25, 0.75 and 1 must be labelled illustrative, not measured Ultimate parameters.
